title: The same number twice
prompt: This finds the centre of a grid tile, and the tile size 64 appears twice. Name it once as `TILE_SIZE` and use the name in both places, so changing the tile size later only takes one edit.
starter:
func solve(column: int) -> int:
	return 64 * column + 64 / 2
hint: One declaration, two uses. The judge checks that 64 now appears only once in your code.
